<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="continueGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.13"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="keyShadow" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="120%" height="130%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="1" stdDeviation="0" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.16"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="23" y="21" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <g fill="#000000">
    <rect x="323" y="14" width="3" height="7" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="328" y="12" width="3" height="9" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="333" y="10" width="3" height="11" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="338" y="8" width="3" height="13" rx="1"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6">
    <circle cx="356" cy="15" r="3"/>
    <line x1="351" y1="21" x2="361" y2="21"/>
    <line x1="353" y1="18" x2="359" y2="18"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="369" y="10" width="18" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="371" y="12" width="13" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="388" y="13" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <polyline points="31,58 22,67 31,76" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="195" y="77" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="34" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">My number is</text>
  <text x="195" y="108" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">We'll use this to verify your account</text>

  <!-- country field -->
  <text x="42" y="151" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">COUNTRY</text>
  <text x="42" y="178" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">United States</text>
  <polyline points="347,168 353,174 359,168" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="192" x2="350" y2="192" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- phone number field -->
  <text x="42" y="224" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">PHONE NUMBER</text>
  <text x="42" y="252" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">+1</text>
  <line x1="72" y1="231" x2="72" y2="260" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="88" y="252" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">(555) 000-0000</text>
  <line x1="40" y1="267" x2="350" y2="267" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="42" y="289" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">Enter a valid mobile number</text>

  <!-- continue action -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="90" y="319" width="210" height="44" rx="62" fill="url(#continueGradient)"/>
    <text x="195" y="347" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">CONTINUE</text>
  </g>
  <circle cx="195" cy="393" r="3" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  <text x="195" y="421" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">Your number is kept private and secure</text>
  <polyline points="183,434 188,439 197,429" fill="none" stroke="#96E063" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="205" y="439" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">No spam, ever</text>

  <!-- keypad surface -->
  <rect x="0" y="564" width="390" height="280" fill="#F2F2F6"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="564" x2="390" y2="564" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- keypad row 1 -->
  <g filter="url(#keyShadow)">
    <rect x="12" y="578" width="114" height=" fifty" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="138" y="578" width="114" height="50" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="264" y="578" width="114" height="50" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
  </g>
  <text x="69" y="604" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">1</text>
  <text x="195" y="604" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">2</text>
  <text x="195" y="618" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">ABC</text>
  <text x="321" y="604" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">3</text>
  <text x="321" y="618" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">DEF</text>

  <!-- keypad row 2 -->
  <g filter="url(#keyShadow)">
    <rect x="12" y="636" width="114" height="50" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="138" y="636" width="114" height="50" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="264" y="636" width="114" height="50" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
  </g>
  <text x="69" y="662" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">4</text>
  <text x="69" y="676" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">GHI</text>
  <text x="195" y="662" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">5</text>
  <text x="195" y="676" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">JKL</text>
  <text x="321" y="662" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">6</text>
  <text x="321" y="676" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">MNO</text>

  <!-- keypad row 3 -->
  <g filter="url(#keyShadow)">
    <rect x="12" y="694" width="114" height="50" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="138" y="694" width="114" height="50" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="264" y="694" width="114" height="50" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
  </g>
  <text x="69" y="720" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">7</text>
  <text x="69" y="734" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">PQRS</text>
  <text x="195" y="720" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">8</text>
  <text x="195" y="734" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">TUV</text>
  <text x="321" y="720" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">9</text>
  <text x="321" y="734" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">WXYZ</text>

  <!-- keypad row 4 -->
  <g filter="url(#keyShadow)">
    <rect x="12" y="752" width="114" height="50" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="138" y="752" width="114" height="50" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="264" y="752" width="114" height="50" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
  </g>
  <text x="69" y="783" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="19" fill="#4A4A4A">＋</text>
  <text x="195" y="783" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">0</text>
  <polyline points="313,779 325,779 330,774 325,769 313,769" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="313" y1="779" x2="313" y2="769" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <rect x="143" y="827" width="104" height="5" rx="101" fill="#000000"/>
</svg>
